title: Palindromic Substrings
prompt:
Count how many substrings of `s` are palindromes (each occurrence counts; single characters count).

**Example**: `"aaa"` → `6` (`"a"`×3, `"aa"`×2, `"aaa"`×1).

Expand around each center and count every palindrome found while growing.
hints: Same centers as Longest Palindromic Substring: odd (i, i) and even (i, i+1).
Each successful expansion step is one more palindrome — count them.

solution.explanation: Each outward step from a center that still matches reveals exactly one new palindrome, so counting expansion steps counts palindromes. O(n²) time, O(1) space — the counting twin of Longest Palindromic Substring.
